title: Day 1: Dallas to the Maine Coast
meta_description: Our New England trip begins at DFW and Boston, then continues to Nubble Lighthouse in York and the Nonantum Resort in Kennebunkport, Maine.
body:
Our November 2026 New England trip begins at DFW. From the airport and flight to Boston, the first film follows the travel day north toward the Maine coast, with the drive and a lunch stop along the way.

At Nubble Lighthouse in York, the film gives us our first coastal views: the lighthouse, the rocky shore and waves moving beside it. The day ends at the Nonantum Resort in Kennebunkport. This is the first of nine films from our trip.

## Places in this film

DFW Airport in Texas; Boston Logan Airport in Massachusetts; the road from Boston to Maine; Nubble Lighthouse in York; and the Nonantum Resort in Kennebunkport.

title: Day 2: Kennebunkport to Bar Harbor
meta_description: A Maine coast travel film from Kennebunkport to Bar Harbor, with Portland Head Light in Cape Elizabeth, the rocky shore and Portland’s waterfront.
body:
Our second day begins around the Nonantum Resort and Kennebunkport before we continue along the Maine coast. The film includes town details and a stop at Portland Head Light in Cape Elizabeth.

The lighthouse and shore share the screen with smaller scenes of pebbles and moving water. After Portland’s waterfront, the film takes us to our evening arrival in Bar Harbor, the next stop in our New England trip.

## Places in this film

The Nonantum Resort and Kennebunkport, Portland Head Light in Cape Elizabeth, Portland’s waterfront, and Bar Harbor, Maine.

title: Day 3: Acadia, West Quoddy Head and Campobello Island
meta_description: From Bar Harbor and Acadia to West Quoddy Head Lighthouse in Lubec and Campobello Island in Canada, with coastal views and small nature details.
body:
We begin in Bar Harbor and spend time in Acadia National Park. From there, the third film continues along the coast to West Quoddy Head Lighthouse in Lubec and Campobello Island in New Brunswick, Canada, before returning to Bar Harbor.

Alongside the lighthouse and rocky coastal views are fishing boats, reeds, pine details and a seabird. These smaller scenes are part of the day’s record too, keeping the film close to the places and moments we filmed.

## Places in this film

Bar Harbor, Acadia National Park and West Quoddy Head Lighthouse in Maine, and Campobello Island in New Brunswick, Canada.

title: Day 4: Bar Harbor Sunrise to the White Mountains
meta_description: A Bar Harbor sunrise, Bangor’s Paul Bunyan statue and the road to New Hampshire, ending at Mountain View Grand in the White Mountains.
body:
Day four begins with the changing light over Bar Harbor and a working boat moving across the water. We spend more time along the waterfront before stopping at the Paul Bunyan statue in Bangor.

Then the film turns toward New Hampshire. Clouds, bridges and the winding road carry this part of the journey into the White Mountains, where the day ends with our evening at Mountain View Grand.

## Places in this film

Bar Harbor and the Paul Bunyan statue in Bangor, Maine; the road toward New Hampshire; and Mountain View Grand in the White Mountains.

title: Day 5: Lower Falls and the White Mountains
meta_description: A day in New Hampshire’s White Mountains: Mountain View Grand, North Conway, the Kancamagus Highway, Lower Falls, mountain overlooks and Littleton.
body:
Our fifth film stays in New Hampshire’s White Mountains. The morning begins at Mountain View Grand with the lawn, wild turkeys and a few details around the hotel, before we head toward North Conway and the Kancamagus Highway.

The drive, Lower Falls and mountain overlooks make up the middle of the day’s film. We finish beside Littleton’s river and mill buildings, moving from the mountain scenery to a closer look at the town.

## Places in this film

Mountain View Grand, the White Mountains, North Conway, the Kancamagus Highway, Lower Falls, mountain overlooks and Littleton, New Hampshire.

title: Day 6: Across Vermont to Quechee
meta_description: From New Hampshire into Vermont: Montpelier, Ben & Jerry’s in Waterbury, Burlington, Lake Champlain, the Waybury Inn and dinner in Quechee.
body:
We leave Mountain View Grand and the Whitefield area in New Hampshire and head into Vermont. Day six takes us through Montpelier, to Ben & Jerry’s in Waterbury, and on to Burlington and the Waybury Inn.

The film includes the State House, playful photographs, colorful building details and a view of Lake Champlain. The evening sequence brings us to dinner at Simon Pearce in Quechee.

## Places in this film

Mountain View Grand and Whitefield, New Hampshire; Montpelier, Ben & Jerry’s in Waterbury, Burlington, Lake Champlain, the Waybury Inn and Simon Pearce in Quechee, Vermont.

title: Day 7: Vermont Villages, Waterfalls and Glassmaking
meta_description: Woodstock, King Arthur Baking in Norwich and Quechee, Vermont, with a waterfall, covered bridge and several close looks at glassmaking.
body:
Day seven begins with hotel and breakfast moments before taking us through Woodstock, King Arthur Baking in Norwich and Quechee. Village scenes lead into views of the waterfall and covered bridge.

The glassmaking sequence gathers several moments at the benches: glowing glass, tools, furnace work and a finished glass form. After those close views, the film returns to the covered bridge and village storefronts.

## Places in this film

Woodstock, King Arthur Baking in Norwich, and Quechee, Vermont.

title: Day 8: Snow, USS Albacore and the Maine Coast
meta_description: Snowy Vermont and covered bridges lead to USS Albacore in Portsmouth, then back to Maine for Nubble Lighthouse and an evening on the coast.
body:
Our eighth film begins with snow around Woodstock and the covered bridges at Taftsville and Quechee. We continue through Concord and Manchester, New Hampshire, before visiting USS Albacore in Portsmouth.

The submarine sequence moves from the propeller and hull to the entrance, controls, bunks, galley and narrow interior spaces. Later, we cross back into Maine and return to Nubble Lighthouse in York, with evening photographs closing the film.

## Places in this film

Woodstock, Taftsville and Quechee in Vermont; Concord, Amoskeag Mills in Manchester and USS Albacore in Portsmouth, New Hampshire; and Kittery, Nubble Lighthouse in York and York Harbor Inn in Maine.

title: Day 9: One More Nubble Sunrise, Then Boston
meta_description: The final New England film opens at Nubble Lighthouse in York, Maine, then follows the road to Boston for bridges, skyline views and city lights.
body:
The final film opens with the changing sky around Nubble Lighthouse in York. The morning continues with the beacon, ocean views, waves and a few more moments beside the shore.

Then we head toward Boston. Bridges, skyline views and tunnels lead to the city at night, closing the nine-film record of our November 2026 New England trip with a coastal morning and a city evening.

## Places in this film

Nubble Lighthouse in York, Maine; the road from York to Boston; and Boston, Massachusetts.
